issues.description: The template Main (commented example code) calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and solution define the method as feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch in the method name/signature in the starter Main can confuse students about the correct API to implement and use.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in template Main.java to use farm.feedAllAnimals() (or rename/alias the method consistently across problem statement, template, and tests). Ensure the starter code and documentation use the same method name so students know which method to implement.

issues.description: The template's example Main uses a method call farm.feed() while the problem statement and the reference solution define and require feedAllAnimals(). This naming mismatch for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals) can confuse students when mapping the provided example code to the required API and the expected implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template example with the problem specification and solution by replacing farm.feed() in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java with farm.feedAllAnimals(), or alternatively add a short delegating method feed() in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals() so the example and required API match.
